description: List incidents for the authenticated user. role=assignee (default) filters the fetched page by assignee; role=requester resolves your requester ID and filters all pages server-side. For group scope use swsd_list_incidents with assigned_to_group=<group_id>. Lookup failures are errors, and totals identify whether they count filtered matches or upstream candidates.

assigned_to_group.description: Filter to incidents assigned to this group ID. Use swsd_list_groups to find the ID. NOTE: this is GROUP id, not user id.

categories.description: Filter to incidents matching ANY of these category names.

created_from.description: Filter to incidents created on or after this ISO date or datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339).

created_to.description: Filter to incidents created on or before this ISO date or datetime.

departments.description: Filter to incidents in any of these department names.

per_page.description: Results per page (1-100). SWSD caps at 100.

priorities.description: Filter to incidents matching ANY of these priorities (e.g. ["High", "Medium"]).

query.description: Free-text search across incident title and description. Same async-indexing caveat as solution search — just-created tickets may not appear for a few minutes.

requester_email.description: Filter to incidents requested by this email.

role.description: assignee: tickets assigned to you (page-local filter). requester: tickets requested by you (server-side filter).

sites.description: Filter to incidents at any of these site names (use swsd_list_sites to discover).

sort_by.description: Sort key. Default is SWSD-side (typically updated_at desc).

sort_order.description: Sort direction. Use uppercase per SWSD convention.

state_is_not.description: Negative state filter: exclude incidents in any of these states (e.g. ["Resolved", "Closed"] to see only open work).

states.description: Filter to incidents matching ANY of these states (e.g. ["New", "Assigned"]).

updated_from.description: Filter to incidents updated on or after this ISO date or datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339).

updated_to.description: Filter to incidents updated on or before this ISO date or datetime. Pair with updated_from for an explicit range.

updated_within.description: Convenience alias for updated_from: "Nh" is an exact hours-ago ISO timestamp; "Nd" and "Nw" use the UTC calendar date N days or N weeks ago. N must be 1-365. Ignored if updated_from is explicitly set.

name: swsd_list_my_incidents

applied_filters.description: Echo of the filters applied to this query — empty object if none. Use this to reason about whether the result count reflects your filters or the tenant total. requester_email is filtered server-side; assignee_email and exact time cutoffs are page-local.

assignee_email.description: The authenticated user's email used as the assignee filter (applied client-side).

url.description: SWSD UI URL for this incident (from href_account_domain).

has_more.description: True when more pages exist beyond this one.

matched_total.description: Total matching records, or null when unknown. After local filtering, known only when all candidate pages were scanned from page 1. Independent of display caps.

next_page.description: The next page number to request, when has_more is true.

per_page.description: Items per page used in the request.

total.description: Total record count when SWSD returns X-Total-Count.

total_scope.description: Scope of the upstream `total`: 'upstream' = candidates before local filtering; 'filtered' = server-filtered count with no local filtering; 'tenant' = unfiltered count; 'unknown' = total absent. Sorting and display options are not filters.

scan.description: Honest accounting of the client-side filter: what was scanned vs matched.

candidates_scanned.description: Server-side rows scanned on this page before client filtering.

client_filter_applied.description: True when assignee or exact time filtering is applied after fetch.

matches_in_page.description: Rows that survived the client-side assignee filter.

unscanned_candidates_remain.description: True if more candidate pages exist server-side. Increase per_page or paginate to scan more.
